rationale: awesome-web-scraping is a static, curated awesome-list directory cataloging web scraping tools, libraries, frameworks, and manuals across multiple programming languages (Python, JS, Go, Ruby, PHP, Java, CLI). It contains no executable code, pipeline implementation, tests, or system architecture documents. It serves purely as reference metadata for discovering ecosystem tools related to browser automation, anti-bot bypass/stealth, queues, and metadata extraction.
limitations: Contains only Markdown list files and no source code, tests, or executable implementations.
Not a core pipeline candidate for Veridian.
